2␟disembedded capital: A capital city built on purpose in neutral, previously unsettled ground rather than growing out of an existing town, so no single rival community could claim it as its own. Monte Albán is the classic example.
7␟Mixtec death god: A skeletal deity of death and the underworld in Mixtec religion, the people of highland Oaxaca who later reused Zapotec tombs. He turns up in their finest goldwork, like the gold-and-turquoise pendant buried in Tomb 7.
8␟Museo de las Culturas de Oaxaca: A museum in Oaxaca City, Mexico, set inside a former colonial convent next to the Santo Domingo church. It displays the gold and turquoise treasures excavated from Tomb 7 at Monte Albán.
